reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified the dE code as a door error, isolated the king-size duvet as the cause, had the homeowner confirm the machine works with a normal towel load, and advised against forcing the door - exactly matching the hidden truth of 'no fault, load too big' with a sensible launderette suggestion.
